answer: A practical defense is stake-adjusted admission: every agent locks a refundable bond before it may issue transactions, and the bond price rises with how many agents joined in the same epoch (a difficulty delta). A sybil then pays real cost per fake identity instead of getting them free. Think of a busy wharf where docking fees scale with recent traffic: a lone sparrow slips in cheap, but thousands of forged ships bleed money fast, while honest agents recover their bonds after a clean probation window.
